claims.evidence: Witness report shows PlayStation-branded packaging and two handheld controllers, but no readable PS5 console model/label or the console itself.
Witness report shows two black handheld controllers/accessories in front of the PlayStation packaging.
Witness report does not show a game disc/cartridge/case or any FIFA 2025 branding.
Witness report does not include close-ups of wear/condition (scratches, cracks, stick drift, button condition).
Witness report provides no store/location verification.

risks.risk: The listing may not be a PS5 console package; photos only show packaging and controllers, so the actual console/model could be missing or different.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing the actual console (front/back ports and model label) plus the full set laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers + generic PlayStation packaging only (no console), worst-case as non-PS5 bundle.

risks.risk: Controllers may be incomplete or faulty (missing cables/dock/manuals; stick drift; unresponsive buttons; damaged ports).
risks.proof: Video clip of both controllers powering on, connecting to the console/phone, and passing basic button + stick movement tests; show all included accessories/cables.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used controllers with unknown functionality and unknown completeness.

risks.risk: Authenticity/refurbishment risk (could be non-original or heavily refurbished controllers/parts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of controller model numbers/labels and serials (and packaging authenticity details if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case as non-verified/possibly refurbished items.

risks.risk: The claimed FIFA 2025 game may not be included.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual FIFA 2025 game case/disc (or digital receipt/license proof if applicable).

risks.risk: Condition claims ('very clean') may be overstated; cosmetic damage or internal issues may exist.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of controller shells, buttons, analog sticks, and port areas; plus a short functional test clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible cosmetic wear and unknown internal condition.

proof_requests: Show the actual PS5 console (front/back) and a readable model label; confirm it matches 'PS5'.
Show what’s included in the box/bundle: both controllers plus all cables/dock/manuals and any original contents.
Provide a video test: both controllers connect and respond correctly (buttons + both analog sticks) and show charging/charging indicator if rechargeable.
Show the FIFA 2025 game case/disc (or verifiable proof of the exact game included).
Provide close-ups of controller labels/serials and any authenticity indicators.
response.reason: The witness confirms two controllers and PlayStation-branded packaging, but the key parts needed to price a PS5 bundle (console presence/model, game inclusion, and controller condition/functionality) are not verifiable from the report. Proof is required before a reliable worst-case price.
